en: You rely on someone to translate your papers and find they got an important detail wrong.
ph_ar: اللي ترجملي الأوراق غلط في معلومة مهمة
ph_en: The person who translated my papers made a serious mistake

en: You face an online system you do not know how to use to finish your paperwork.
ph_ar: الموقع الإلكتروني متاع الإدارة ما فهمت فيه شي
ph_en: I can't figure out the online system to complete my application

en: A document expires while you are waiting for your appointment.
ph_ar: الوثيقة فات أجلها وأنا نستنى في الموعد
ph_en: My document expired while I was waiting for the appointment

en: You hesitate between handling the paperwork yourself and hiring a specialist.
ph_ar: محتار نكمل الإجراءات وحدي ولا نجيب محامي
ph_en: I can't decide whether to do the paperwork myself or hire a lawyer

en: Your application is refused and you do not understand why or what options you have.
ph_ar: رفضوا طلبي وما فهمتش علاش
ph_en: My application was refused and I don't understand why

en: You have to take repeated days off to finish procedures.
ph_ar: كل مرة ناخو إجازة على خاطر الأوراق
ph_en: I keep taking days off work to deal with paperwork

en: You move to another country and start getting your documents recognised all over again.
ph_ar: بدلت البلاد ورجعت من الأول في الأوراق
ph_en: I moved country and have to start all the paperwork from scratch

en: You feel flustered explaining your situation to an official.
ph_ar: نتلخبط كي نحكي وضعي قدام الموظف
ph_en: I get flustered explaining my case to officials

en: A volunteer helps you understand a procedure that seemed complicated.
ph_ar: متطوعة فهمتني الإجراءات اللي كنت حاسبها معقدة
ph_en: A volunteer helped me understand a complicated procedure

en: You obtain stable residency after years of waiting.
ph_ar: أخيرًا خذيت الإقامة بعد سنين
ph_en: I finally got permanent residency after years of waiting

en: Your child asks you to speak the local language in front of their friends instead of Arabic.
ph_ar: بنتي قالتلي ما تحكيش بالعربي قدام صحابي
ph_en: My daughter asked me not to speak Arabic in front of her friends

en: Your son understands your language but answers you in another.
ph_ar: ولدي يفهم العربي بس يجاوبني بالفرنساوي
ph_en: My son understands Arabic but always answers in English

en: Your daughter asks why some family customs differ from her classmates'.
ph_ar: بنتي تسألني علاش عاداتنا مختلفة على صحباتها
ph_en: My daughter asks why our family is different from her friends'

en: You find it hard to explain a religious occasion to your child's teacher.
ph_ar: ما عرفتش نفسر رمضان لمعلمة ولدي
ph_en: I struggled to explain Ramadan to my child's teacher

en: Your son needs suitable food on a school trip.
ph_ar: ولدي عندو رحلة مدرسية ونخاف على الماكلة
ph_en: My son has a school trip and I worry about halal food

en: You try to teach your children Arabic but they see it as extra homework.
ph_ar: نحب نعلم ولادي العربي وهوما يعتبروه واجب زايد
ph_en: I want my kids to learn Arabic but they see it as a chore

en: Others pronounce your child's name differently and you wonder whether to correct them.
ph_ar: المعلمة تنطق اسم ولدي بطريقة غالطة
ph_en: The teacher keeps mispronouncing my son's name

en: Your son wants to change his name because he gets comments about it.
ph_ar: ابني يبي يبدّل اسمه خاطر يعلقوا عليه
ph_en: My son wants to change his name because he's teased about it

en: You discover your child is ashamed of the food you pack in their bag.
ph_ar: بنتي تحشم من الماكلة اللي نحطهالها
ph_en: My daughter is embarrassed by the lunch I pack her

en: You are unsure which language to speak at home.
ph_ar: محتارين بأي لغة نحكيو في الدار
ph_en: We can't decide which language to speak at home

en: Your children visit your homeland and cannot easily talk with their grandparents.
ph_ar: ولادي ما يعرفوش يحكيو مع جدهم
ph_en: My kids can't really talk with their grandparents back home

en: Your child refuses to travel to your country because they prefer spending the holiday with friends.
ph_ar: ولدي ما يحبش يمشي للبلاد في العطلة
ph_en: My son doesn't want to visit our home country for the holidays

en: You learn the customs of the new society from your children.
ph_ar: ولادي هوما اللي يعلموني عادات البلاد
ph_en: My children are teaching me how things work here

en: Your child translates for you in an important situation and you feel pride and embarrassment together.
ph_ar: بنتي ترجمتلي عند الطبيب وحسيت بالفخر والحشمة
ph_en: My daughter had to translate for me at the doctor's and I felt proud and embarrassed

en: You fear putting too much responsibility on your son because you need his help.
ph_ar: نخاف نحمّل ولدي أكثر من عمره
ph_en: I worry I'm putting too much on my son's shoulders

en: Your child asks "Which country am I from?" and you look for an answer that fits their identity.
ph_ar: ولدي سألني من وين أنا بالضبط
ph_en: My son asked me where he's really from

en: You disagree with the wider family about raising your children abroad.
ph_ar: العائلة في البلاد تنتقد تربيتي لولادي هنا
ph_en: Family back home criticise how I raise my kids abroad

en: You discover your children combine two cultures in a way you did not expect.
ph_ar: ولادي جمعوا بين ثقافتين بطريقة غريبة
ph_en: My kids blend two cultures in ways that surprise me

en: You organise a small cultural activity so your children's friends learn about their home country.
ph_ar: نظمت نشاط صغير باش صحاب ولادي يعرفوا بلادنا
ph_en: I organised a small event to share our culture with my kids' friends

en: Your son asks about family history and you begin recording its stories and photos.
ph_ar: ولدي سألني على تاريخ العائلة وبديت نجمع الصور
ph_en: My son asked about our family history so I started collecting our stories

en: You understand the official work language but not your colleagues' jokes.
ph_ar: نفهم لغة الخدمة بس ما نفهمش نكت الزملاء
ph_en: I understand the work language but not my colleagues' jokes

en: You hesitate to speak in a meeting for fear of pronunciation mistakes.
ph_ar: نخاف نحكي في الاجتماع على خاطر النطق متاعي
ph_en: I avoid speaking in meetings because of my accent

en: You manage to explain a complex idea in a language you learned recently.
ph_ar: قدرت نشرح فكرة صعيبة باللغة الجديدة
ph_en: I explained a complex idea in my new language for the first time

en: You feel your experience does not show because your language is weak.
ph_ar: خبرتي ما بانتش بسبب اللغة
ph_en: My experience doesn't show because my language skills are weak

en: Your direct manner is taken as coldness despite your good intentions.
ph_ar: يحسبوني جاف خاطر نحكي بصراحة
ph_en: My directness at work comes across as rude

en: You take an ordinary remark as an insult because communication styles differ.
ph_ar: حسيت ملاحظة زميلي إهانة وطلع عادي عندهم
ph_en: I took a colleague's comment as an insult but it was normal for them

en: You are asked to join a work event that does not suit some of your convictions.
ph_ar: عزموني لحفلة خدمة فيها خمر
ph_en: I've been invited to a work party with alcohol and I'm unsure what to do

en: You struggle to understand a long lease full of jargon.
ph_ar: عقد الكراء طويل وما فهمت فيه شي
ph_en: I can't understand my rental contract

en: Services you used to get immediately now need an appointment.
ph_ar: كل حاجة هنا تحتاج موعد
ph_en: Everything here needs an appointment weeks in advance

en: You need to find a doctor who understands your language.
ph_ar: نلوج على طبيب يحكي العربي
ph_en: I'm looking for a doctor who speaks my language

en: You cannot describe a symptom precisely when you see the doctor.
ph_ar: ما عرفتش نوصف للطبيب شنو يوجعني
ph_en: I couldn't explain my symptoms to the doctor

en: Your expectations about hosting guests and visits differ from the local ones.
ph_ar: هنا ما يزوروش بعضهم كيما عنا
ph_en: People here don't visit each other the way we do back home

en: A relative visits and expects you to be free throughout their stay.
ph_ar: قريبي جا يزورني ويحسابني فاضي ليه نهار كامل
ph_en: A relative is visiting and expects me to be available all the time

en: You feel expected to buy gifts for everyone each time you go home.
ph_ar: كل ما نروّح لازم هدايا للعائلة الكل
ph_en: Every time I go home I'm expected to bring gifts for everyone

en: You spend most of your holiday visiting relatives with no time to rest.
ph_ar: العطلة الكل في الزيارات وما ارتحتش
ph_en: My whole holiday goes on visiting relatives and I never rest

en: You struggle with short days or long nights.
ph_ar: النهار قصير والظلام يقلقني
ph_en: The short dark days here really get me down

en: You face your first harsh winter far from the climate you knew.
ph_ar: أول شتاء قاسي في الغربة
ph_en: My first harsh winter abroad is hard

en: You learn to use a bicycle or public transport to manage daily life.
ph_ar: نتعلم نستعمل المترو والبيسكلات
ph_en: I'm learning to get around by bike and public transport

en: A good relationship with a neighbour begins after months of simple greetings.
ph_ar: بعد شهور من السلام وليت صاحب مع جاري
ph_en: After months of just saying hello I've become friends with my neighbour

en: You become the person who helps newcomers after needing help yourself.
ph_ar: وليت نعاون الجدد كيما عاونوني
ph_en: Now I help newcomers the way others once helped me

en: Your friend returns home and you lose the person closest to you abroad.
ph_ar: صاحبي رجع للبلاد وبقيت وحدي هنا
ph_en: My closest friend abroad moved back home and I'm alone

en: A family member returns home while you stay because of your commitments.
ph_ar: أختي رجعت للبلاد وأنا بقيت
ph_en: My sister moved back home and I had to stay

en: You visit your childhood home and find your memories clearer than the place itself.
ph_ar: زرت دار طفولتي وحسيت الذكريات أوضح من البلاصة
ph_en: I visited my childhood home and it felt smaller than my memories

en: Your relatives think your opinions changed because you live abroad.
ph_ar: يقولولي تبدلت من وقت ما سافرت
ph_en: My relatives say I've changed since I moved abroad

en: You defend your adopted country to your family and your home country to your colleagues.
ph_ar: نلقى روحي ندافع على البلدين
ph_en: I find myself defending each country to the other side

en: You feel you must keep explaining your choices to both sides.
ph_ar: ديما مطالب نبرر اختياراتي للجهتين
ph_en: I always have to justify my choices to everyone

en: Your relationship with an old friend changes because your experiences now differ.
ph_ar: صاحبي القديم ما عادش يفهمني
ph_en: My old friend and I have grown apart since I left

en: You realise you cannot attend every occasion however hard you try.
ph_ar: ما نقدرش نحضر المناسبات الكل مهما حاولت
ph_en: I can't make it to every family occasion no matter how hard I try

en: You must choose to visit one parent instead of attending another family event.
ph_ar: لازمني نختار بين زيارة أمي والعرس
ph_en: I have to choose between visiting my mother and a family wedding

en: You decide to give fewer gifts and fear it will be seen as stinginess.
ph_ar: نقصت الهدايا وخايف يقولوا بخيل
ph_en: I want to cut back on gifts but I'm afraid they'll think I'm stingy
